title: Three Generations and Nilpotent Hitchin Zero-Modes on the Genus-3 Quaternion Cover

scope.frame: Superelliptic quaternion cover w^4 = 4x^3 - g_2 x - g_3 of elliptic curve E_tau at ground state tau_* with Q_8 deck group and surface Hitchin system
scope.object: derivation of exactly 3 chiral fermion generations g=3 and exact 1+2 block-diagonal Gram overlap matrix G_{1,{2,3}} = 0 from Z(Q_8) central parity on the nilpotent Hitchin orbit selected by S_6(SL(2, Z)) = 0 (P-394)
scope.hypotheses: Quaternion cover Y of genus 3; Q_8 Galois group; finite unwarped L^2 top-form norm enforcing S_6(SL(2, Z)) = 0; bundle V = O_Y + K_Y

claim_one_line: THREE GENERATIONS AND NILPOTENT HITCHIN ZERO-MODES (P-394): on the degree-8 quaternion cover w^4 = 4x^3 - g_2 x - g_3 of genus g=3, canonical differentials decompose under Q_8 into a singlet omega_1 = dx/w^2 and a doublet (omega_2, omega_3) = (dx/w^3, x dx/w^3); central parity Z(Q_8) = {+/- 1} unconditionally enforces G_{1,2} = G_{1,3} = 0 for any invariant Hodge metric, deriving the 1+2 block structure; the surface quadratic Casimir c(tau) in S_6(SL(2, Z)) = {0} uniquely pins the Hitchin background to the nilpotent orbit without continuous tuning.
weave_or_thread: weave (derivation of 3 chiral generations and 1+2 block structure from the genus-3 quaternion cover and nilpotent Hitchin orbit)
